title: Title-Clearing Fee in the Owner's Total Loss Payment
content:
**Rule.** Under the Physical Damage Coverage (Comprehensive and Collision), a title-clearing fee is added to the owner's tax-and-title payment for the owner's cost of clearing the title:
- **Lessor.** When the coverage's loss payee is a lessor, the lease termination fee of 40.0 USD is added.
- **Lienholder paid off.** When the loss payee is a lienholder whose payoff on the total loss declaration is no more than the total loss payment made to it, the lien release fee of 22.5 USD is added.
- **Lienholder still owed.** Otherwise, for a lienholder still owed after that payment, nothing is added.

### Payoff compared with the payment to the lienholder (hypothetical)

| Payoff recorded on the declaration | Total loss payment made to the lienholder | Fee added |
|---|---|---|
| 8,200.00 USD | 9,100.00 USD | 22.50 USD |
| 9,100.00 USD | 9,100.00 USD | 22.50 USD |
| 9,750.00 USD | 9,100.00 USD | Nothing (still owed) |
| Lessor listed as loss payee | Any | 40.00 USD |
